access_notes: Pattern C, refreshed 2026-09-26. NOTE the canonical URL has NO trailing slash - the trailing-slash form 301-redirects here, and the DB now stores the redirect target, so a crawler saves a hop. The integrated-care-board-meetings landing is static HTML (local browser-UA curl: HTTP 200, 82KB) listing dated ICB Board meetings, each linking to a per-meeting sub-page of the form /icb/integrated-care-board-meetings/navigate/23515/<id>. Each per-meeting page does NOT offer a single combined pack; instead it lists numbered individual paper PDFs (Paper 0 Agenda, Paper 2a Minutes, Paper 4 Chair report, Paper 5 CEO report, Paper 6 BAF, etc.), each downloaded via /download_file/<file-id>/452. To assemble a full pack a crawler must follow each meeting page and fetch all Paper N download_file links (the agenda is 'Paper 0'). The board meets roughly bi-monthly; the listing currently spans 5 February 2025 through 4 November 2026. Server-side WebFetch socket-hangs on this host, so prefer the local static path here - the reverse of most orgs in this DB.
pack_pattern_hints: agenda = 'Paper 0 - Public Agenda'; collect all Paper N PDFs (no combined pack)

access_notes: URL PATCHED 2026-10-03 (Pattern F + cluster board): NHS Cornwall and Isles of Scilly ICB now holds its ordinary board meetings jointly with NHS Devon ICB (QJK) as the 'South West Peninsula Board' (SW-PEN cluster), and the packs are published on the dedicated joint site swpboard.nhs.uk (site title 'NHS CIOS and Devon ICB'). The old own-domain page cios.icb.nhs.uk/about/meetings/ is still live but stops at the 28 May 2026 extraordinary meeting and says future dates are TBC; use it only for the pre-cluster archive (direct PDFs on docs.cios.icb.nhs.uk/DocumentsLibrary/NHSCornwallAndIslesOfScilly/Organisation/PublicMeetings/BoardMeetings/{YYYY}/{YYYYMM}/, grouped by financial year). Strategy on the new landing: static WordPress page (plain browser-UA curl works, no Playwright) listing each joint meeting with direct PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/. Naming varies by meeting: 'SWPB-Public-29.01.2026-Meeting-Papers-1.pdf', 'SWPB-Meeting-30-July-2026-Agenda-and-Papers-v4.pdf', 'SWP-Board-24.09.2026-Agenda-and-Reports.pdf'. Take the 'Meeting Papers' / 'Agenda and Papers' / 'Agenda and Reports' file as the main pack; separate 'Appendices' PDFs and individual SWPB26-NNN item PDFs accompany it, and minutes are uploaded months later. Bi-monthly cadence (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov); next 26 Nov 2026. The joint AGM pack (NHS-CIOS-and-NHSD-AGM-*) is also listed. Note the swpboard.nhs.uk/meetings/ path recorded as cluster_meeting_url now 404s - this page is the live joint archive. Re-verified 2026-10-10: local browser-UA curl was refused with a generic '403 - Forbidden' page (shared with three trust sites that morning) while server-side WebFetch listed every 2026 pack; try WebFetch on a local 403 before repointing.
